notes.title: Big Update! Turbocharge Your Escape and Discover Hidden Treasures!
notes.notes:
[h2]A fresh update for Maze Gold Run is here! Experience new gameplay mechanics, find treasure chests, and enjoy a streamlined UI and added visual effects.[/h2]
[h3]Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics[/h3]
If you pick up a life phial and your health is near 100, you'll get a temporary speed boost. This new mechanic rewards good health management and could give you an edge when time is running out.
[h3]Treasure Chests in Remote Corners[/h3]
In addition to gold coins, you can now find treasure chests hidden in far corners of the maze. These provide a substantial gold boost, useful for skill improvement at the entrance.
[h3]UI Overhaul[/h3]
The interface has been updated with clearer icons and new menu sound effects, making navigation straightforward.
[h3]Visual and Graphic Tweaks[/h3]
The game now features some visual improvements and a slightly enhanced graphic style, for better readability and aesthetics.
